context:
REVERTED 2026-10-24: after #3400 merged, 3 of 4 completed Trunk push runs failed (40130311002 at c525b4988, 40130816953, 40138162734; also trunk-coverage 40138380752) with tests/integration/test_clickhouse_local_cross_platform.py::TestClickHouseLocalCrossPlatform::test_local_client_session_handling: 'EmbeddedServer already initialized with path :memory:, cannot connect with different path /tmp/...chdb'. chdb's embedded server is process-global: once any test on a worker opens the default in-memory client (for example the SSB chdb_client fixture from #3388), a file-backed client on the same worker fails.
